messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} I hope you've
been saving Bells, because
it's {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00} day!
{07 0b 00}Picked up anything nice
yet? Maybe some furniture?
{01 00 00 05 00}Or a little knickknack?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} loodan, et sa
oled kellasid kogunud, sest
täna on {ff 00 00 03}kirbuturg{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 0b 00}Kas oled midagi kena juba
leidnud? Ehk mööblit?
{01 00 00 05 00}Või mõne nipsasja?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Didja go to {04 0b 00}'s
house? There's some nice
stuff there.
You {01 00 00 05 00}do know that the {ff 00 00 03}Flea
Market{ff 00 00 00} is today, right?

{07 16 00}Well, you're wasting time!
Quick! Check out everyone's
house and buy their stuff!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kas sa käisid tema, {04 0b 00},
majas? Seal on kena
kraami.
Sa {01 00 00 05 00}tead ju, et täna on
{ff 00 00 03}kirbuturg{ff 00 00 00}, eks?

{07 16 00}Noh, sa raiskad aega!
Kiiresti! Vaata kõigi maju
ja osta nende kraami!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I think I like new furniture
a bit more than I like used
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Used furniture has a warm,
well-loved feeling, like my
room is filled with history.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma arvan, et uus mööbel
meeldib mulle pisut rohkem
kui kasutatud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Kasutatud mööblil on soe,
armastatud tunne, nagu mu
tuba oleks täis ajalugu.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You know, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} it IS
good to visit other people's
houses, but{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
You should know that
someone might be waiting
to visit your house, too.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tead, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} on hea
külastada teiste inimeste
maju, aga{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Sa peaksid teadma, et
keegi võib oodata võimalust
ka sinu maja külastada.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you're making
me nervous, pacing around
like that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Just go back and chill at
your house. People will show
up sooner or later!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa teed mind
närviliseks, kui kõnnid nii
ringi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Mine lihtsalt tagasi ja ole
oma majas. Inimesed tulevad
varem või hiljem!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I love the {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 16 00}but how can I shop properly
when everyone's outside?
{07 0e 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I want to shop
at your house, but you're
not there{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma armastan {ff 00 00 03}kirbuturgu{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 16 00}aga kuidas ma saan
ostlema, kui kõik on väljas?
{07 0e 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma tahan sinu
majas ostlema, aga sa pole
seal{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
